captions.detailed: This 3D model features a realistic, heavy-duty bench vise designed with a dense, blocky aesthetic. It consists of a flat rectangular base, a fixed rear jaw assembly, a sliding front jaw block, and a metal screw mechanism with a cylindrical crank handle. The main body of the vise is colored in a dark matte charcoal/black, while the screw shaft, handle bar, and end caps are rendered in a contrasting metallic light gray.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a realistic bench vise. It should feature a heavy, dark-colored rectangular base, a fixed rear jaw, a sliding front jaw, and a metallic gray screw mechanism with an adjustable sliding handle bar.
captions.factory: Construct the vise by first creating a flat rectangular base using box primitives. Model the fixed rear jaw block and the sliding front jaw as separate box extrusions. Create the cylindrical screw shaft and the perpendicular handle bar using cylinder primitives, positioning them at the front of the assembly. Apply a dark matte material to the base and jaw bodies, and a light gray metallic material to the screw and handle components.
